item.text:
As of **October 18, 2026**, here are the standard API rates for each provider’s flagship model, in **USD per million tokens**:

| Provider | Flagship model | Input | Output |
|---|---|---:|---:|
| Anthropic | Claude Opus 5.5 | $4 | $20 |
| OpenAI | GPT-6 Astra | $10 | $50 |
| Google | Gemini 4 Argon | $2 | $10 |

Sources: [Anthropic pricing](https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/about-claude/pricing), [OpenAI pricing](https://developers.openai.com/api/docs/pricing), [Google Gemini API pricing](https://ai.google.dev/gemini-api/docs/pricing).

Google’s listed rates are introductory prices through **November 30, 2026**; from December 1, they rise to **$4 input / $20 output**. Google’s output price includes thinking tokens. These are standard rates; caching, batch processing, and other pricing options may differ.
